note_reasoning_effort: Thinking was disabled via reasoning_effort:none on the OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. With thinking ON, qwen35b-arc spent its entire token budget in the reasoning field and emitted empty content (finish_reason=length) even at 4000 tokens, so it could never return a fenced program. With thinking OFF it answers directly in content.
synthesis_attempts: >=1 (loop entered SYNTHESIZE and adopted a program; RunSummary does not count individual synth attempts. decide_calls=98 vs 80 executed turns implies ~18 non-executing decide calls spent on synthesis/repair)
note_best_pass_rate: The adopted program was accepted provisionally (validated against 0 transitions at adoption time -- the cold-start rule), then mispredicted every subsequent observed transition: divergences=80 over 80 executed actions. So its empirical accuracy against real ls20 dynamics was 0.0 -- it adopted a program, but never a VALIDATING one.
stop_reason: budget (80-action cap hit; ~14.5 min of the 25-min wall cap)
note_multimodality: Pre-run sanity check: qwen35b-arc read a tiny 3x3 BEFORE|AFTER|DIFF composite via /v1 image_url parts and via native /api/chat images, correctly naming the single changed (red) cell. Vision genuinely reaches the model.
